question: Which sectors grew their Treasury holdings since 2019, and are states still the main funders?
start: Fed Z.1 financial accounts, second quarter 2026, Treasury securities by holder (via FRED)

links.claim: Of about 29.0 trillion Treasury securities held (Z.1, second quarter 2026), the rest of the world held about 9.27 trillion at market value (about 32%), the Fed 4.08, money funds 3.28, US banks 1.80 and the household residual (which includes hedge funds) 2.83. At end 2019 the rest of the world held 6.92 of 16.93 (about 41%), money funds 1.12 and the household residual 1.39

actor.name: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

evidence.what: Z.1 all sectors, Treasury securities, asset
Z.1 rest of the world, Treasury securities, market value
Z.1 money market funds, Treasury securities
Z.1 households and nonprofits, Treasury securities, market value

links.claim: Foreign official holdings fell from 66.5% of foreign holdings (January 2015) to 40.2% (August 2026). Official holdings in dollars fell 9.2% while all foreign holdings rose 50%

evidence.what: TIC history and table 3, computed by the Data lane (R10A-07)

links.claim: States no longer fund the growth. Since 2019 the new money came from domestic money funds (about plus 2.2 trillion), the leveraged household residual with hedge funds (about plus 1.4 trillion), the Fed, and private foreign buyers booked in custody centres. Official foreign holders shrank
footprints_expected: Z.1 sector levels growing as stated
TIC official flat while private grows
Auction allotments shifting to investment funds and others

footprints_found.what: Z.1 money funds 1.12 to 3.28 trillion, household residual 1.39 to 2.83
TIC foreign official 3,703.8 (Jan 2023) to 3,755.6 (Aug 2026) while total rose about 2 trillion

footprints_missing: Auction allotments by investor class not pulled
Z.1 mixes face and market value across series, so shares are approximate
rivals: Official holders still fund it, but through private custodians that TIC counts as private (Treasury warns of this)
The Fed's holdings growth since 2019 (about plus 1.5 trillion) was the biggest single funder over the period, and QT is now reversing that
links.reveal: Fed Z.1 for the third quarter of 2026, about 11 December 2026. TIC annual survey, end of February 2027

rival_hypotheses.text: A broad domestic and foreign investor base, with a shrinking role for foreign states
Foreign states agree to fund the deficit
Money funds, hedge funds and private foreigners buy because the yields and trades pay
Custody bias moves official money into private lines
